description: Source file implementing Gloo device factory functions for distributed communication, including device creation for TCP, TLS, UV, and IBVerbs transports, with platform-specific checks and registry registration.

methods.name: makeTCPDevice
methods.description: Creates a TCP device with specified interface or hostname, supports lazy initialization.

methods.name: makeTCPTLSDevice
methods.description: Creates a TCP TLS device with specified interface or hostname, does not support lazy init.

methods.name: makeUVDevice
methods.description: Creates a UV device with specified interface or hostname.

methods.name: makeIBVerbsDevice
methods.description: Creates an IBVerbs device with specified interface, hostname is optional.

methods.name: makeGlooDevice
methods.description: Internal helper to select and create a Gloo device based on environment or platform.
